## Summary

Concrete problem and resulting behavior; link the Linear ticket. Keep this
brief current (roughly 100–200 words), replacing settled questions rather
than appending memos. Link detailed measurements and logs.

## Validation

Targeted checks and their head/date. Distinguish verified, unrun and inherited
results; current CI is authoritative. Link a failing-before regression for fixes.

## Remaining

Only real blockers, explicit holds, approvals or live checks still needed.
Remove this section when empty. Review from the brief/diff/current checks;
read historical or minimized discussion only when relevant (docs/review-context.md).
